    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">混沌工程基本原理</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<div data-page-id="Hv2fdWsYao7SZtxowsvczFxkn5b" data-lark-html-role="root" data-docx-has-block-data="true">
<h3 class="heading-3 ace-line old-record-id-Ir1Ydbt6uosLLaxX19AcO4FGnvh">1、诞生</h3>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-DN7LdzknVosuF7xjJiuc8oNHnpc">先看下这个生动的图吧。</div>
<div class="image-uploaded gallery old-record-id-UiDSdpvxdoMTwvxxLmucv1uen5b" data-type="image" data-ace-gallery-json="{&quot;items&quot;:[{&quot;uuid&quot;:&quot;b722d879-6a80-4943-b7b2-70eb7d248954&quot;,&quot;height&quot;:885,&quot;width&quot;:402,&quot;currHeight&quot;:885,&quot;currWidth&quot;:402,&quot;natrualHeight&quot;:885,&quot;natrualWidth&quot;:402,&quot;pluginName&quot;:&quot;imageUpload&quot;,&quot;scale&quot;:1,&quot;src&quot;:&quot;https%3A%2F%2Finternal-api-drive-stream.feishu.cn%2Fspace%2Fapi%2Fbox%2Fstream%2Fdownload%2Fpreview%2FOiYKbZEW0oiBuwxvqlicKOI1nAc%2F%3Fpreview_type%3D16&quot;,&quot;file_token&quot;:&quot;OiYKbZEW0oiBuwxvqlicKOI1nAc&quot;,&quot;image_type&quot;:&quot;image/png&quot;,&quot;size&quot;:351166,&quot;comments&quot;:[]}]}"><img src="https://weikezhijia.feishu.cn/space/api/box/stream/download/asynccode/?code=NWQ5Y2YxNTQ2MzczMWI1NjgzMTQ2YTJmZmMzMTY5NDRfTWdOU3NxSk9JU041VURjUmR1TnNoOXBOdVRXU0FRcnRfVG9rZW46T2lZS2JaRVcwb2lCdXd4dnFsaWNLT0kxbkFjXzE3NjE4ODk1MDg6MTc2MTg5MzEwOF9WNA" data-single-block="true" data-snapshot="" data-suite="" data-src="https://internal-api-drive-stream.feishu.cn/space/api/box/stream/download/all/OiYKbZEW0oiBuwxvqlicKOI1nAc/?mount_node_token=UiDSdpvxdoMTwvxxLmucv1uen5b&amp;mount_point=docx_image" data-width="402" data-height="885" data-lark-image-uri="drivetoken://OiYKbZEW0oiBuwxvqlicKOI1nAc" data-lark-image-width="402" data-lark-image-height="885"></div>

<div class="image-uploaded gallery old-record-id-NQIWdmqs5og73Xxo1YFctRrvnXf" data-type="image" data-ace-gallery-json="{&quot;items&quot;:[{&quot;uuid&quot;:&quot;44c2e598-bb2b-46da-9920-fbf31a126610&quot;,&quot;height&quot;:637.2517985611511,&quot;width&quot;:399,&quot;currHeight&quot;:637.2517985611511,&quot;currWidth&quot;:399,&quot;natrualHeight&quot;:666,&quot;natrualWidth&quot;:417,&quot;pluginName&quot;:&quot;imageUpload&quot;,&quot;scale&quot;:0.9568345323741008,&quot;src&quot;:&quot;https%3A%2F%2Finternal-api-drive-stream.feishu.cn%2Fspace%2Fapi%2Fbox%2Fstream%2Fdownload%2Fpreview%2FB0w1byjwGovyTgxp7kdcIFuJnNh%2F%3Fpreview_type%3D16&quot;,&quot;file_token&quot;:&quot;B0w1byjwGovyTgxp7kdcIFuJnNh&quot;,&quot;image_type&quot;:&quot;image/png&quot;,&quot;size&quot;:205403,&quot;comments&quot;:[]}]}"><img src="https://weikezhijia.feishu.cn/space/api/box/stream/download/asynccode/?code=YjhmYTViMjVlMTI2ZTUzYWVjMTU4ODU4NmFmZmJlODlfNDh2NElhb0RvYUdwS0JERGJBeDJTVm82bGFSRDAycU1fVG9rZW46QjB3MWJ5andHb3Z5VGd4cDdrZGNJRnVKbk5oXzE3NjE4ODk1MDg6MTc2MTg5MzEwOF9WNA" data-single-block="true" data-snapshot="" data-suite="" data-src="https://internal-api-drive-stream.feishu.cn/space/api/box/stream/download/all/B0w1byjwGovyTgxp7kdcIFuJnNh/?mount_node_token=NQIWdmqs5og73Xxo1YFctRrvnXf&amp;mount_point=docx_image" data-width="417" data-height="666" data-lark-image-uri="drivetoken://B0w1byjwGovyTgxp7kdcIFuJnNh" data-lark-image-width="417" data-lark-image-height="666"></div>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-EymZdcGp8oeeDmxYfw6coQWvnKg"><strong>文字版</strong></div>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-Bq0FdJOPeoWou4xTroRcEimxnbq">2008年之前，国际巨型视频网站Netflix的模式还是自建机房，自己维护，由于在全球有超1亿用户，所以流量特别大。有一天服务宕机，导致部分国家的不可用长达1天时间，于是他们决定将服务器迁移到AWS上，做了多节点分布式部署，同时增加对服务<strong>可用性、容错性、健壮性的实验，而这套实验方法就是混沌工程的前身</strong>。他们将这种实验方法和工具抽象剥离出来后，命名为<strong>Choas Monkey</strong>，寓意为上蹿下跳捣乱的猴子（看来猴子这个物种无论海内海外，都认为他们喜欢捣乱，想想大闹天宫的大圣）。</div>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-QhUCd2x8ooH7bhx3F2ocOTCGned">经过几年的发展，这种思想被业界争相效仿，来提升自己公司的产品。而就在这个时候，2014年Netflix宣布新增一个叫混沌工程师的职位，代表Netflix将混沌工程融入了自己的运维过程，这也直接激起了混沌工程的热度。</div>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-DRcRdBEU5o3cIBxmYCscfHzdnuc">2015年，Netflix与社区正式提出了混沌工程原则，从此Choas Monkey不再是一种工具、一组方法，而是真正形成了一套理论。</div>
<div class="image-uploaded gallery old-record-id-QWBadrL7joLpixxlLEGcONI9neb" data-type="image" data-ace-gallery-json="{&quot;items&quot;:[{&quot;uuid&quot;:&quot;7f867f7d-2f2c-49fb-85c2-8f7647492e64&quot;,&quot;height&quot;:651,&quot;width&quot;:1374,&quot;currHeight&quot;:651,&quot;currWidth&quot;:1374,&quot;natrualHeight&quot;:651,&quot;natrualWidth&quot;:1374,&quot;pluginName&quot;:&quot;imageUpload&quot;,&quot;scale&quot;:1,&quot;src&quot;:&quot;https%3A%2F%2Finternal-api-drive-stream.feishu.cn%2Fspace%2Fapi%2Fbox%2Fstream%2Fdownload%2Fpreview%2FEw5Ub1ZM1oCWpAxx2Pncx35Hnih%2F%3Fpreview_type%3D16&quot;,&quot;file_token&quot;:&quot;Ew5Ub1ZM1oCWpAxx2Pncx35Hnih&quot;,&quot;image_type&quot;:&quot;image/png&quot;,&quot;size&quot;:782153,&quot;comments&quot;:[]}]}"><img src="https://weikezhijia.feishu.cn/space/api/box/stream/download/asynccode/?code=ODgwNzFjMTcwOGE4ODIxN2M4ZmI0ODg0MjAzZDQyNTFfSmIwVWF5UXZBdFNmeFBDM3hLeE0zZVVZY2lNTVhETGZfVG9rZW46RXc1VWIxWk0xb0NXcEF4eDJQbmN4MzVIbmloXzE3NjE4ODk1MDg6MTc2MTg5MzEwOF9WNA" data-single-block="true" data-snapshot="" data-suite="" data-src="https://internal-api-drive-stream.feishu.cn/space/api/box/stream/download/all/Ew5Ub1ZM1oCWpAxx2Pncx35Hnih/?mount_node_token=QWBadrL7joLpixxlLEGcONI9neb&amp;mount_point=docx_image" data-width="1374" data-height="651" data-lark-image-uri="drivetoken://Ew5Ub1ZM1oCWpAxx2Pncx35Hnih" data-lark-image-width="1374" data-lark-image-height="651"></div>
<h3 class="heading-3 ace-line old-record-id-Yn16dtw8QoPAB1xoyx3cviOjnzd">2、定义与作用</h3>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-GZ0sdyXOsoDfcWxXeLfcgbOInqg"><strong>定义</strong></div>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-NL85dHSscoNkWoxdLqmcQLZOn2f">混沌工程（Chaos Engineering）是一种通过主动向系统中注入故障或异常条件，以验证系统在真实环境中的韧性、发现潜在弱点，并提升系统容错能力的技术实践。它旨在将不可预测的故障转化为可控实验，帮助构建高可用的分布式系统。-- <strong>来自Deepseek</strong></div>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-Gk9QdL05Yop8xYxXAeYcSwZYnhh">&nbsp;</div>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-SNEQdd4sro3seDxHWXHco8UAnPh">混沌工程是一种通过主动在系统中引入可控的故障和不确定性，来测试和验证系统韧性的实践方法。</div>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-OV1Zdq89noGcS4xtAU1c3UnNndc">其核心目标是：在系统发生意外故障（如服务器宕机、网络延迟、数据丢失等）前，主动发现潜在的脆弱点，从而提升系统在真实复杂环境中的稳定性、可靠性和容错能力。</div>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-TZRidaKALoF7XwxF1lPcJ0H2nhh">简单来说，就像给系统“打疫苗”，通过模拟各种可能的“疾病”（故障），让系统提前适应并增强抵御风险的能力，减少实际运行中突发故障造成的损失。 -- <strong>来自豆包</strong></div>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-BWOcdh1Mro9TmUxQWsac849dnxb">&nbsp;</div>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-URZvdUHDPogvVAxvWNkce59inxg"><strong>作用</strong></div>
<ol class="list-number1" start="1">
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-ANXpd16WNoEgzGxvgQUcJ3aCn2e" data-list="number">提前暴露潜在故障点，降低线上故障发生率与复发率</li>
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-J5h1dJXvboVp80x06kzcHYvHnch" data-list="number">验证故障恢复机制有效性</li>
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-GeA9dPkRboDXyHxefqQcJrn6nEc" data-list="number">构建系统自愈能力，提高故障应急效率</li>
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-W7BEdZFTVo6DaWxZbWqco7aknZf" data-list="number">提高系统架构的容错能力与健壮性</li>
</ol>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-KPGodLaVHorxdPxCiAKcYmuZnXb">&nbsp;</div>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-NGtNdCYaLoADM5x4BETcrPHjnKh"><strong>经典案例</strong></div>
<ul class="list-bullet1">
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-GtxSdnh17ocHRmxmXXXcpaSSnub" data-list="bullet">Netflix 的 Chaos Monkey：随机终止生产环境虚拟机，迫使服务实现自动化容错。</li>
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-FoFvdYhzNoF41HxZuWAcaBPvn59" data-list="bullet">NASA航天系统：在阿波罗计划中通过“故障注入”测试飞船的生存能力。</li>
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-B1Sydo6UmoyEqSxlv5Bc3FWRnth" data-list="bullet">银行系统演练：定期模拟数据中心宕机，验证异地多活的切换时效。</li>
</ul>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-SGaQdWQYUotr1zxciGacgGQRnFg">再来个图，直观了解某银行应用混沌工程的案例：</div>
<div class="image-uploaded gallery old-record-id-JRSEdHJnhoL1ZfxqmkEcRkrEnPb" data-type="image" data-ace-gallery-json="{&quot;items&quot;:[{&quot;uuid&quot;:&quot;6a102efb-b73b-4292-bae2-137bd5fc2a6e&quot;,&quot;height&quot;:1300.0059999999999,&quot;width&quot;:118,&quot;currHeight&quot;:1300.0059999999999,&quot;currWidth&quot;:118,&quot;natrualHeight&quot;:11017,&quot;natrualWidth&quot;:1000,&quot;pluginName&quot;:&quot;imageUpload&quot;,&quot;scale&quot;:0.118,&quot;src&quot;:&quot;https%3A%2F%2Finternal-api-drive-stream.feishu.cn%2Fspace%2Fapi%2Fbox%2Fstream%2Fdownload%2Fpreview%2FXOGbbFwqLoihm0xjsdGcRAYenzf%2F%3Fpreview_type%3D16&quot;,&quot;file_token&quot;:&quot;XOGbbFwqLoihm0xjsdGcRAYenzf&quot;,&quot;image_type&quot;:&quot;image/jpeg&quot;,&quot;size&quot;:2026786,&quot;comments&quot;:[]}]}"><img src="https://weikezhijia.feishu.cn/space/api/box/stream/download/asynccode/?code=MGQyYmZkMDQ5N2Y4NTE4ZDVmYTdkOTU1ZDg0YWI4YTVfS2JIRmV0SGNUcVJjOTNJUzkwdExVRTNKRnVidjN6T0ZfVG9rZW46WE9HYmJGd3FMb2lobTB4anNkR2NSQVllbnpmXzE3NjE4ODk1MDg6MTc2MTg5MzEwOF9WNA" data-single-block="true" data-snapshot="" data-suite="" data-src="https://internal-api-drive-stream.feishu.cn/space/api/box/stream/download/all/XOGbbFwqLoihm0xjsdGcRAYenzf/?mount_node_token=JRSEdHJnhoL1ZfxqmkEcRkrEnPb&amp;mount_point=docx_image" data-width="1000" data-height="11017" data-lark-image-uri="drivetoken://XOGbbFwqLoihm0xjsdGcRAYenzf" data-lark-image-width="1000" data-lark-image-height="11017"></div>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-XlssdorjKow3s8xSdgecJfu6nyg"><strong>几个好理解的场景</strong></div>
<ul class="list-bullet1">
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-IiFudtybZobq1sx7zcmc4BIanEh" data-list="bullet">服务器宕机： 模拟某个服务器失效，观察系统是否能通过负载均衡快速恢复。</li>
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-R1Esd100joTO43xyUi6cypZMnIc" data-list="bullet">网络延时： 模拟高延迟或丢包场景，评估用户体验是否受到影响。</li>
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-AQp0ddepmo4Q6xxIzWtc1JzMnfb" data-list="bullet">流量激增： 测试系统在突发流量下的响应能力，找到可能的性能瓶颈。</li>
</ul>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-NWrIdxLQ8oM0moxiqF4cPWiEnUe">混动工程是一种主动发现问题的方式，而不是被动等待事故发生。就像 Netflix 最开始的Chaos Monkey工具（随机关闭生产环境中的服务，通过实践验证系统的健壮性）。</div>
<h3 class="heading-3 ace-line old-record-id-IiPjd2iZAo1C8fxLzzKcUB8dncf">3、实施原则</h3>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-UmqgduiacoHHC4xmy9LckHOxnPg">Netflix首先提出的五大原则：</div>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-LXOedzja0oaXKbx2a5fcB4BZnZb">建立稳定状态的假设</div>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-UPEfdKH7votyrbxHfoucyr0bnwf">当系统处于稳定状态时，可以通过一些指标来定义这一状态（如请求成功率、延迟百分位）。系统在混沌工程实验完成后，这些指标无法快速恢复，可以认为这个系统是不稳定的。</div>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-Nb3ldh60yo5IwEx2GPGcJJbOnDd">多样化真实事件</div>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-LmMOdLYuHoZzKGxhbqHcbZKinPg">不能够凭空想像出一些事件来验证，而是引入那些真实存在的，频繁发生的，且影响重大的事件。给这些事件做混沌实验才有价值。如磁盘故障、网络延时、主机宕机等。</div>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-XKkodo4jforSj6xEur9cW1Lrnof">在生产环境中进行实验</div>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-GM4CdVeQ2oqyAexd86xc0a3SnEd">尽量在生产或接近生产的环境中进行测试，生产环境的多样性是其它环境所不具备的。混沌工程的价值就是保证生产上的业务连续不中断。</div>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-QDXEdlO7WoAzioxbZoIcU7BmnTN">持续运行自动化实验</div>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-JP4mdf1WFo9vAuxrhIsc1VwQnog">实施混沌工程实验一般最开始是人工手动操作，当对业务有足够的信心时，要把混沌实验融入到持续集成过程。在版本升级、不断迭代的过程中，持续不断自动化地做验证，最大程度保证业务的连续性验证。</div>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-S94NdOtXIockK3xRaH4cqU7lnbO">最小化影响范围</div>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-GvHkdIgLVoToBtxZcVacVRkHn6c">做混沌工程的意义就是保证生产上的业务，在实施混沌实验时也必须保证对线上业务影响最小。在实施实验时，从小范围开始，不断扩大范围，避开高风险时段，如选择业务量最小的时段实施实验。</div>
<div class="image-uploaded gallery old-record-id-Hx1jd7N3coZV9zxxe9vcEn3vn7e" data-type="image" data-ace-gallery-json="{&quot;items&quot;:[{&quot;uuid&quot;:&quot;0fb44957-e3a6-47e8-85b8-8be36ca10745&quot;,&quot;height&quot;:603,&quot;width&quot;:1080,&quot;currHeight&quot;:603,&quot;currWidth&quot;:1080,&quot;natrualHeight&quot;:603,&quot;natrualWidth&quot;:1080,&quot;pluginName&quot;:&quot;imageUpload&quot;,&quot;scale&quot;:1,&quot;src&quot;:&quot;https%3A%2F%2Finternal-api-drive-stream.feishu.cn%2Fspace%2Fapi%2Fbox%2Fstream%2Fdownload%2Fpreview%2FBO61btHYqofvWJxhXtKcfPSKneX%2F%3Fpreview_type%3D16&quot;,&quot;file_token&quot;:&quot;BO61btHYqofvWJxhXtKcfPSKneX&quot;,&quot;image_type&quot;:&quot;image/png&quot;,&quot;size&quot;:417409,&quot;comments&quot;:[]}]}"><img src="https://weikezhijia.feishu.cn/space/api/box/stream/download/asynccode/?code=ZDJmZDUzN2JjOTE3MDk1NTY2NjQ0MDAyOTZjMjNmNjdfd0lpWUdDWGlzeUM3V2RxNHRMckRMS0FpMVo4SW5mUGFfVG9rZW46Qk82MWJ0SFlxb2Z2V0p4aFh0S2NmUFNLbmVYXzE3NjE4ODk1MDg6MTc2MTg5MzEwOF9WNA" data-single-block="true" data-snapshot="" data-suite="" data-src="https://internal-api-drive-stream.feishu.cn/space/api/box/stream/download/all/BO61btHYqofvWJxhXtKcfPSKneX/?mount_node_token=Hx1jd7N3coZV9zxxe9vcEn3vn7e&amp;mount_point=docx_image" data-width="1080" data-height="603" data-lark-image-uri="drivetoken://BO61btHYqofvWJxhXtKcfPSKneX" data-lark-image-width="1080" data-lark-image-height="603"></div>
<h3 class="heading-3 ace-line old-record-id-JGQ2dyIREoRwloxacvUcQ08yn1b">4、主流工具</h3>
<ol class="list-number1" start="1">
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-DL1JdY9PZoB47yxxrnlc0VINnDg" data-list="number">Chaos Monkey （开源）/ˈkeɪɒs/</li>
</ol>
<ul class="list-bullet1">
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-W5c5dQkW6ooKagxQdv6cR9Wmnka" data-list="bullet">特点：由 Netflix 开发，用于随机终止生产环境中的服务实例，测试系统的恢复能力。</li>
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-N3pkdm1TNo60dQxMg0ZctJLhnJh" data-list="bullet">优势：简单易用，能够快速暴露系统中的单点故障。</li>
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-AYz3dzmoEo7Yp7xyQxgcT5UDnof" data-list="bullet">适用场景：适合已经具备一定弹性和容错能力的大型分布式系统。</li>
</ul>
<ol class="list-number1" start="2">
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-OCPmdKhS7o1j6XxzQPycColdn9c" data-list="number"><strong>ChaosBlade （开源）</strong></li>
</ol>
<ul class="list-bullet1">
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-Ak3cd2sk1oFisJxXlYncln15nGb" data-list="bullet">特点：阿里巴巴开源，支持多种故障注入场景，包括CPU、内存、网络、磁盘、进程、文件系统等。</li>
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-DWtUdbYxUoPkEgxucGAcpZRMnCb" data-list="bullet">优势：多环境支持（物理机、虚拟机、容器等），灵活的实验场景，轻量级且易于集成。</li>
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-Ko2XdxvD0oW8GdxieC4c4MsGnle" data-list="bullet">适用场景：适合混合云或复杂基础设施的企业。</li>
</ul>
<ol class="list-number1" start="3">
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-Fkb7dZND1odnXOxPZdecuV5onAb" data-list="number"><strong>Chaos Mesh（开源）</strong></li>
</ol>
<ul class="list-bullet1">
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-ApT9drOf1or3NfxwBW7c9M9hnSw" data-list="bullet">特点：PingCAP 开源，专注于K8S环境的混沌工程工具，支持 Pod 故障、网络故障、文件系统故障等20+实验类型，提供Chaos Dashboard管理界面。</li>
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-JZdKdwxRNouIjgxhHipch0tcnKe" data-list="bullet">优势：深度集成K8S，支持基于标签的精准故障注入。</li>
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-YcFXdNu0Foii1JxGLxfcjUnKnkc" data-list="bullet">适用场景：适合基于K8S的云原生系统，尤其是微服务架构和分布式数据库。</li>
</ul>
<ol class="list-number1" start="4">
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-B7TMdjRBioGVtRxQbHEc1YFonfl" data-list="number">LitmusChaos （开源） /ˈlɪtməs/</li>
</ol>
<ul class="list-bullet1">
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-H3Dhd9ywyon3hSxo2rBcNMYYnag" data-list="bullet">特点：MayaData 开源，基于K8S的开源工具，专注于云原生环境下的韧性测试。</li>
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-WPYQdDI7WoNyMsx0tvHcNT0Dnxd" data-list="bullet">优势：与K8S生态紧密集成，能够针对容器、Pod、节点等不同层次进行故障模拟。</li>
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-IOlRd0xluoE6JaxrMYycIoPdnTc" data-list="bullet">适用场景：适合云原生环境下的系统，尤其是基于K8S构建的微服务架构。</li>
</ul>
<ol class="list-number1" start="5">
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-FlB2da2bcoKP9DxEg4PcklWAn6d" data-list="number">ChaosMeta （开源）/ˈmɛtə/</li>
</ol>
<ul class="list-bullet1">
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-WFjcdRUqyoucxtxC3HMc4fgTngg" data-list="bullet">特点：专注于大规模分布式系统的故障注入和韧性测试，支持节点故障、网络分区、服务延迟等。</li>
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-NLqWdhbOQonK6WxWCv3c4i9Sn05" data-list="bullet">优势：支持实验编排和复杂故障链模拟，适合超大规模系统。</li>
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-C4qRdDE76osN9kxy2S3cSv4ZnAM" data-list="bullet">适用场景：适合需要测试大规模分布式系统韧性的企业，如大型互联网公司或金融科技公司。</li>
</ul>
<ol class="list-number1" start="6">
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-E97Od9R9LoNyYxx5RTXcEAUen7g" data-list="number">Gremlin （商业） /ˈɡremlɪn/</li>
</ol>
<ul class="list-bullet1">
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-FCnOdULAcou3sJxp9W0cott3npc" data-list="bullet">特点：企业级混沌工程平台，支持100+故障场景（CPU满载、网络延迟、磁盘故障等），集成Prometheus等监控工具，具备可视化仪表盘和可靠性评分。</li>
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-Fqdzdc04roLN2Tx5f5EcjRX7nYt" data-list="bullet">优势：提供更细粒度的故障模拟，能够模拟复杂的故障场景，并且有良好的用户界面和报告功能。</li>
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-QhGTd6EXIoBlnTxZ9TmcHbbhnzc" data-list="bullet">适用场景：适合需要精细控制实验的企业，尤其是对系统稳定性要求极高的行业，如金融、医疗等。</li>
</ul>

<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-UTKod65H8oMu4oxLPpScc5KFnVd">代码实现</div>
<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-YWQfdsYYYowLTZxEhRAcVmu2nBg">最小单元是一个for循环：</div>

<div class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-Ox6xdg8XxoeDabxeW2TcYCzDnpc">官网直观展示的能力：</div>
<ul class="list-bullet1">
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-E8IadlbbWosdlvxpNzZcd4xlnbd" data-list="bullet">可视化操作界面（Chaos Dashboard）：可以通过 Web UI 设计混沌实验场景、编排故障注入流程，并实时监控实验运行状态，降低混沌工程实施门槛。</li>
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-PbgUd9OtnoUb9KxFhXKc13Lfnyd" data-list="bullet">文档与社区资源：包含详细的使用指南、故障类型说明及社区支持信息，便于用户快速上手和实践。</li>
<li class="ace-line ace-line old-record-id-WLdTdoeieokCQ9xwGbVcWPNjnJc" data-list="bullet">集成 DevOps 工具链：支持与 GitHub Actions 等 CI/CD 系统集成，实现持续混沌测试。</li>
</ul>
